describe: a straight stretch of mainline railway track seen from straight above, as a texture that repeats along its length: grey crushed-granite ballast filling the whole strip edge to edge, its shoulders a little darker at the long edges; 12 evenly spaced pale grey concrete sleepers lying across it, each about two thirds of the strip's width; two steel rails running the whole length exactly on the two thin grey guide lines, each a bright polished running strip with a darker rusty-brown edge either side; light rust and oil stains between the rails
